thread:
alex_support: Heads-up — Novus Health procurement just told the account team they will not accept any invoice until we have an official PO. They also said their tax team needs an EU VAT reverse-charge statement on the invoice. Billing is paused on this customer. Any quick path to get them billed or at least provide a proforma?

mikaela_am: looping in @jordan_finance. who is the procurement contact? do they require a special vendor code field? :thinking_face:

jordan_finance: Hi — we can’t issue a final invoice without a PO for enterprise customers if procurement mandates it. Workaround: create a proforma invoice that they can attach their PO to, then convert to final invoice once we receive the PO. I’ll need: billing contact email, vendor code (if they insist), and exact VAT wording they want.

alex_support: Procurement email is procurement@novushealth.eu (forwarded from customer thread). Vendor code they provided: NH-IT-0021. Quote from them: "please include our internal SVC_ORDER field and VAT reverse charge language: 'VAT reverse charged under Article 194 of the VAT Directive'"

jordan_finance: Perfect — creating proforma now. I’ll set terms Net30, include a placeholder line: "Purchase Order: <PO NUMBER>" and a description line "SVC_ORDER: NH-IT-0021". I’ll also add the exact VAT reverse-charge text they requested.

billing-bot: Proforma created INV-PROFORMA-2026-045. PDF uploaded to billing portal: https://billing.redwood.ai/drafts/INV-PROFORMA-2026-045 :page_facing_up:

mikaela_am: I’ll email the procurement contact and drop a short PO template they can complete. Email I’ll send:```Hi Procurement Team,

Attached is a proforma invoice (INV-PROFORMA-2026-045) — please confirm your official Purchase Order number and return the completed PO using the template below so we can issue the final invoice.

Required fields in PO:
- Purchase Order Number
- Customer SVC_ORDER (e.g., NH-IT-0021)
- Billing contact email
- Cost center / charge code

Sample PO (copy/paste):
Company: Novus Health
PO Number: __________
SVC_ORDER: NH-IT-0021
Billing contact: procurement@novushealth.eu
Cost center: __________

Thanks,
Mikaela (Redwood Account Team)```

sam_cs: quick note — customer said they won’t sign a PO unless we confirm EU data residency (they want eu-west-1). legal already approved standard residency language from our template, are we good to confirm that?

alex_support: yes — we already confirmed they can be served from eu-west-1 for hosted plans. copied legal clause in the email: "Data processed by Redwood under this Agreement will be stored and processed in the EU (eu-west-1) unless otherwise agreed in writing."

jordan_finance: Sent proforma + instructions at 13:42 GMT, cc'd procurement@novushealth.eu. Next steps: once they reply with PO number we will convert INV-PROFORMA-2026-045 to final invoice and proceed with billing. If they return a PO with a specific vendor-code format, we’ll mirror it in the final invoice.

alex_support: customer reply thread (pasted): "Thanks — we'll circulate internally. FYI this may take ~10 business days. We require the PO to be attached to any invoice for payment."

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled — proforma INV-PROFORMA-2026-045 will auto-expire in 30 days if no PO attached.

mikaela_am: leaving a follow-up task: if no PO in 7 business days, escalate to sales-ops to prioritize their PO approval. tagging @sam_cs to monitor relationship risk. :eyes:

alex_support: assigning to support-escalations for tracking. closing loop here — proforma provided, customer asked for PO first, finance confirmed process. I’ll update thread when PO arrives or if procurement escalates. :white_check_mark:
